item.title: Large Language Models
item.description:
Intending to answer a few things to understand Large Language Models (llms)

Introduction

What are LLMs? What types of LLMs exist? What differentiates them? What are features, parameters in a model? What is model training? What is fine tuning? What is the difference? What does it mean a model “predicts” Why is hardware important for running models? Why are GPUs expensive? What are the alternatives - TPUs? Why is running models locally challenging? Mobile models? What software is deisgned to interface with models? Why are some models called “frontier models”? What does it mean?
